_comment: REFERENCE ONLY — do not fill this file in.
This filename is intentionally NOT gitignored so the template stays in the repo,
which means a real key pasted here could be committed. Download the real JSON
from Google instead and save it as service-account.json (that name IS ignored),
or just upload the downloaded file straight at /setup without saving it here.
focus-log only reads two fields: private_key and client_email.
private_key is a ~1700-character PEM block. It is NOT the 40-hex-character
private_key_id — Google shows the private key only once, in the JSON it
generates when you create the key, and can never show it again.
